title: 第二十一章 一拳击出诡异躲避第二十二章 暗器能人命案现场
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 浮云飘散，月如钩。
一缕月光飒然的落在贾环的身上。
贾环已经退到荣喜堂外院。
站在那儿，岿然不动！
王子腾脸上不断的变幻。
理上他不占，今日来问罪贾环，全然是因为气急败坏了。
他对梵楼拐卖人口的事情也很不耻，但这事让他在京师中丢尽了脸面。
以后说起来，一个小辈就敢不请示，随意动他的地盘，那他还如何管着下面的人。
王子腾双拳发出咯咯声，拳已握紧。
夜凉如水。
贾环眯着眼，随时注意着。
刚才质问出来，就已让王子腾下不来台了。
但王子腾忍耐力还是很强的，并没动手。
“好好好。”
王子腾忽然笑了起来，连说了三声好，接着看向贾政。
“生了个好儿子啊！”
听到王子腾阴阳怪气的声音。
贾政如坠冰窟。
“小畜生啊小畜生，你竟然如此，你怎敢如此？”
贾政双眼倒竖，冲着贾环摇头戟指，但吸取了之前的教训，他并不敢对着贾环冲上去。
王子腾见贾政除了骂，就没别的手段了，心中不喜。
这爹怎么当的，皮鞭都没有？
今日必须让贾环知道好歹，不然他是真的不知天高地厚。
王子腾本不想动手，叵耐一旁的贾政实在不堪重用。
再看向贾环，见其一脸的悠然，更加气愤。
好小子，今日必让你断两根骨头。
“贾环，好侄儿，今日舅舅出一招，来试试你的身手！”
王子腾先用话把这事定义为自己试侄儿身手，以免落人话柄。
同时说明自己只出一招，否则就显得以大欺小了。
他也不怕被贾环听了这话有所准备。
他的一拳，就算是明说了，也不是一般人能够躲得过的。
拼杀了这么多年，像贾环这么嫩的娃子，一招就能让他躺个三五月。
话音刚落，倏地一拳既出！
如白虹贯日冲着贾环而去！
贾环一直都在防备着，又听王子腾出言，知他忍不住要出手了。
content_en:
The clouds are floating away, and the moon is like a hook.
A ray of moonlight fell on Jia Huan's body.
Jia Huan has retreated to the outer courtyard of Rongxi Hall.
Stand there, motionless!
Wang Ziteng's face kept changing.
Logically speaking, he didn't take advantage of it. He came to question Jia Huan today just because he was angry.
He was also very shameless about Fan Lou's human trafficking incident, but this incident made him lose face in the capital.
From now on, if a junior dares to touch his territory without asking for permission, how can he control the people below him?
Wang Ziteng made a clenching sound with his fists, which were clenched.
The night is as cold as water.
Jia Huan squinted his eyes, always paying attention.
The question just now made it impossible for the prince to leave the stage.
But Wang Ziteng still had strong endurance and did not take action.
"Okay, okay."
Wang Ziteng suddenly laughed, said hello three times, and then looked at Jia Zheng.
"I gave birth to a good son!"
I heard Wang Ziteng's strange voice.
Jia Zheng was like falling into an ice cave.
"Little beast, little beast, you are like this, how dare you do this?"
Jia Zheng's eyes stood upright and he shook his head and pointed his halberd at Jia Huan, but after learning from the previous lesson, he did not dare to rush towards Jia Huan.
Wang Ziteng felt unhappy when he saw that Jia Zheng had no other choice but to scold him.
How did this father become a father? He didn’t even have a whip?
Today we must let Jia Huan know what is going on, otherwise he really doesn't know what the world is up to.
Wang Ziteng didn't want to take action at all, but Jia Zheng, who was standing aside, was really unusable.
Looking at Jia Huan again, he was even more angry when he saw the leisurely look on his face.
Good boy, I will break two of your bones today.
"Jia Huan, my dear nephew, today my uncle will make a move, let's try your skills!"
Wang Ziteng first defined the matter in words as a test of his nephew's skills to avoid being blamed.
At the same time, he explained that he only had one move, otherwise it would appear that he was bullying the small.
He was not afraid that Jia Huan would be prepared after hearing this.
His punch, even if it was stated clearly, was not something that ordinary people could avoid.
After fighting for so many years, a young kid like Jia Huan could be put in bed for three to five months with just one move.
As soon as he finished speaking, a punch came out!
Like a white rainbow shooting through the sun, it's heading towards Jia Huan!
Jia Huan had always been on guard, and after hearing Wang Ziteng's words, he knew that he couldn't help but take action.
